assessment.body:
Monday 7:30 PM IST. Day 59. Three facts that permanently reframe this war.

THE PUTIN-ARAGHCHI MEETING — WHAT IT PRODUCED
• Boris Yeltsin Presidential Library, St Petersburg (CNN, TASS confirmed)
• Putin: "Iran fighting courageously for independence and sovereignty"
• RIA: Russia confirmed maintaining intelligence ties with Tehran
• TASS: Putin received written message from Mojtaba Khamenei
• Putin extended best wishes for Khamenei's health — acknowledging incapacitation
• What was NOT produced: no security guarantee framework, no peace proposal, no Hormuz mechanism
• Russia gave Iran political solidarity and intelligence — not a deal

THE IRAN HORMUZ PROPOSAL — REVERSE SEQUENCING
• Iran: reopen Hormuz AFTER US ends the war AND provides no-resumption guarantees
• US position: Hormuz opens first, then deal is negotiated
• These are mutually exclusive sequencing positions
• This is the core deadlock that has defined the West Asia War since day one
• WH: will not negotiate through the press
• The structural gap has not narrowed — Iran has just made it more explicit

THE GOLDMAN/CITI UPGRADE — PERMANENT SHIFT
• Goldman Sachs Q4 Brent: $90 (was $80). WTI: $83 (was $75)
• Citi Q4 Brent base case: $80
• "Largest supply shock in history of the oil market"
• Supply chain bottlenecks + mine clearing (6 months) + Ras Laffan (3-5yr repair)
• Brent anchored $80-90 post-deal, not returning to pre-crisis
• For India: Goldman $90 Q4 = petroleum import bill structurally elevated through 2026

LEBANON — THE SECONDARY PRIMARY RISK
• 14 killed Sunday alone — deadliest day since Lebanon ceasefire
• Netanyahu: Hezbollah "dismantling the ceasefire"
• Iran has explicitly linked Hormuz to Lebanon throughout this war
• Lebanon collapse = Iran's stated justification for Hormuz escalation
• This is not a background risk — it's a trigger that can move overnight

INDIA'S STRUCTURAL REALITY AT DAY 59
• Brent $107 — OMC hike Rs 2-5/L imminent within 2-3 days
• Goldman $90 Q4 = import bill elevated regardless of outcome
• Rupee 95.00 — ATL zone, every $1 Brent rise = $1.4B annual import increase
• Kharif fertiliser at risk if Hormuz stays closed through May
• Tuesday 9:15 AM: Scenario A 35% (Iran proposal traction → Nifty 23,900-24,200)
• Scenario B 45% (Stalemate → 23,500-23,800, OMC hike announced)
• Scenario C 20% (Lebanon + Hormuz incident → below 23,000)

VERDICT: Monday produced three permanent facts: Russia is all-in with Iran (intelligence, solidarity, Khamenei channel). Iran has a Hormuz proposal but it requires the war to end first — the reverse of what the US needs. Goldman and Citi have formally acknowledged the oil disruption is structural through 2026. The West Asia War has moved from an acute crisis that might resolve in weeks to a structural economic disruption that will define India's energy costs for the remainder of 2026. The question for India is no longer when Hormuz reopens — it is how to manage a world where Brent averages $80-90 for the rest of the year.
